segments.speaker: host
segments.text: Welcome back to AlphoGen Weekly. Today: turning a single link into a finished video.

segments.speaker: guest
segments.text: Love it. So I paste a product page and the system does the research for me?

segments.speaker: host
segments.text: Exactly. It reads the page, collects the media, and drafts a script automatically.

segments.speaker: guest
segments.text: And I can still edit everything before anything gets rendered, right?

segments.speaker: host
segments.text: Always. Nothing is charged until you confirm the final render.

segments.speaker: guest
segments.text: What about a two-person format like this — a real podcast layout?

segments.speaker: host
segments.text: That's exactly what this prototype is testing: timing, captions, and the layout.

segments.speaker: guest
segments.text: Nice. Voice-first now, lip-sync as a premium upgrade later. Let's ship it.
